cards.front: light source
cards.back: Something that makes its own light, such as the Sun, a torch or a candle.
cards.say: light source. Something that makes its own light, such as the Sun, a torch or a candle.

cards.front: Is the Moon a light source?
cards.back: No. The Moon only reflects light from the Sun.
cards.say: Is the Moon a light source? No. The Moon only reflects light from the Sun.

cards.front: Which is a light source, the Sun or a mirror?
cards.back: The Sun. A mirror only reflects light.
cards.say: Which is a light source, the Sun or a mirror? The Sun. A mirror only reflects light.

cards.front: Name two light sources.
cards.back: The Sun and a lamp. A torch, a candle and a fire work too.
cards.say: Name two light sources. The Sun and a lamp. A torch, a candle and a fire work too.

cards.front: reflect
cards.back: When light bounces off a surface.
cards.say: reflect. When light bounces off a surface.

cards.front: Does light travel in straight lines?
cards.back: Yes.
cards.say: Does light travel in straight lines? Yes.

cards.front: shadow
cards.back: A dark shape made when an object blocks light.
cards.say: shadow. A dark shape made when an object blocks light.

cards.front: Which materials make good shadows?
cards.back: Opaque materials, such as wood or metal, because they block light.
cards.say: Which materials make good shadows? Opaque materials, such as wood or metal, because they block light.

cards.front: Does a transparent material make a shadow?
cards.back: No, or only a very faint one, because most light goes through.
cards.say: Does a transparent material make a shadow? No, or only a very faint one, because most light goes through.

cards.front: How does a shadow form?
cards.back: An object blocks the light, so a dark area forms behind it.
cards.say: How does a shadow form? An object blocks the light, so a dark area forms behind it.

cards.front: What happens to a shadow when the object moves closer to the light?
cards.back: The shadow gets bigger.
cards.say: What happens to a shadow when the object moves closer to the light? The shadow gets bigger.

cards.front: What happens to a shadow when the object moves away from the light?
cards.back: The shadow gets smaller.
cards.say: What happens to a shadow when the object moves away from the light? The shadow gets smaller.

cards.front: When is your shadow longest in the day?
cards.back: In the early morning and late afternoon, when the Sun is low.
cards.say: When is your shadow longest in the day? In the early morning and late afternoon, when the Sun is low.

cards.front: When is your shadow shortest in the day?
cards.back: Around midday, when the Sun is high.
cards.say: When is your shadow shortest in the day? Around midday, when the Sun is high.

cards.front: Where is your shadow if the Sun is on your left?
cards.back: On your right side.
cards.say: Where is your shadow if the Sun is on your left? On your right side.

cards.front: Why can you not see in the dark?
cards.back: There is no light to bounce from objects into your eyes.
cards.say: Why can you not see in the dark? There is no light to bounce from objects into your eyes.

cards.front: What do we need to see an object that is not a light source?
cards.back: Light must reflect off it into our eyes.
cards.say: What do we need to see an object that is not a light source? Light must reflect off it into our eyes.

cards.front: Which is dangerous to look at, the Sun or a lamp?
cards.back: The Sun. Never look straight at the Sun.
cards.say: Which is dangerous to look at, the Sun or a lamp? The Sun. Never look straight at the Sun.

cards.front: Why do we wear sunglasses and a hat?
cards.back: To protect our eyes and skin from the strong light of the Sun.
cards.say: Why do we wear sunglasses and a hat? To protect our eyes and skin from the strong light of the Sun.

cards.front: Which shadow is darker, one made by a thick card or by tracing paper?
cards.back: Thick card, because it blocks more light.
cards.say: Which shadow is darker, one made by a thick card or by tracing paper? Thick card, because it blocks more light.

cards.front: Do shadows have the same shape as the object?
cards.back: Yes, they have a similar shape.
cards.say: Do shadows have the same shape as the object? Yes, they have a similar shape.

cards.front: How can you make a shadow puppet show?
cards.back: Shine a torch at a puppet in front of a wall.
cards.say: How can you make a shadow puppet show? Shine a torch at a puppet in front of a wall.

cards.front: Why are some road signs shiny?
cards.back: They reflect light from car headlights so drivers can see them.
cards.say: Why are some road signs shiny? They reflect light from car headlights so drivers can see them.
